notes.title: Now with a savegame feature, non-binary and ace options!
notes.notes: We’ve implemented a new save game feature, allowing players to save a game for importing into the upcoming sequel [i]Exile of the Gods[/i]. [i]Champion of the Gods[/i] also now contains new, added options to play as non-binary, asexual, or aromantic, in keeping with Choice of Games’ commitment to diverse representation.
